newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato sees CPI declining in months ahead.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato sees CPI declining in months ahead.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday he expected consumer price inflation to continue to decline in coming months after a tame August figure.

As announced earlier on Friday, August inflation rose 0.3 percent month-on-month, for an unchanged 3.7 percent year-on-year. The imposition of special taxes had pushed up forecasts to 0.5 percent and 3.9 percent.

Speaking to journalists after a cabinet meeting, Rato said "It (the decline in inflation) is benefitting economic growth expectations and it should continue (to decline) in coming months." --Sharman Esarey, Madrid Newsroom +34 1 585 2167
